definitions: A computer program that has been trained on a massive amount of text data and can generate human-like text, translate languages, write different kinds of creative content, and answer your questions in an informative way.
An artificial intelligence model characterized by its vast number of parameters and training on extensive text datasets, enabling sophisticated natural language processing tasks.
examples: The new large language model can summarize articles.
Researchers are improving large language model capabilities.
Many applications now integrate a large language model.
